lines.text: The concept is looked up as a Restaurant (Planning Code § 102).
Zoning district NCT-MISSION: a Restaurant on the first story is a conditional use (Planning Code § 754, in force from 2024-01-14 (Ord. 249-23, File No. 230701)).

NCT-MISSION: the table caps the eating and drinking uses (Restaurants, Limited Restaurants and Bars) in the district at 179, and a new one is not permitted if it would take the total above that (Table 754 Note 7, in force from 2024-01-14 (Ord. 249-23, File No. 230701)). The records do not show how many there are.

Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District: Any proposed Restaurant in the sub-area east of the western boundary of the Mission Street NCT and north of Cesar Chavez Street needs Conditional Use, with or without alcohol. Zoning district NCT-MISSION lies inside that sub-area: a conditional use (Planning Code § 249.60(f)(1), in force since before 2022-01-01).

Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District: A Restaurant operating as a Bona Fide Eating Place may serve alcohol; its licence may be transferred from inside or from outside the district. The district adds no Conditional Use for the licence itself (but see subsection (f)(1) for the Restaurant use in the sub-area). This rule asks for nothing here (Planning Code § 249.60(b)(1)(A), in force since before 2022-01-01).

Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District: The § 202.2 operating conditions apply to every liquor establishment in the district; new, relocated or expanded ones, and any with a licence referred to Planning by ABC, must also provide outside lighting, keep window signage to 33% and keep 50% clear glazing on street-facing facades. This is a requirement, not a control (Planning Code § 249.60(d), in force since before 2022-01-01).

Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District: No new establishment with an ABC Type 75 licence (brewpub) may open in the subsection (f) sub-area. The description does not say what alcohol will be served (beer and wine, or spirits too), so the licence type is not known and this is not decided (Planning Code § 249.60(f)(2), in force since before 2022-01-01).
Zoning district NCT-MISSION has no hours of operation control on file (Planning Code § 754, in force since before 2022-01-01), so this trigger does not apply.
No active ABC licence of a type the rules read (Types 41, 42, 47, 48, 61, 75) is on file at 2573 Mission St, so the records do not show what the space is used as now.
The description says the space is vacant and does not say what it was last used as, so whether the proposed use (Restaurant) is a change of use is not established.

Building Code: a restaurant or bar is Assembly Group A-2, and a space for fewer than 50 people is Group B (2022 California Building Code).
basis.code_section: California Building Code 2022 edition, § 303.1.1, § 303.3; San Francisco Building Code § 106A.1.12 as amended by Ord. 241-24

basis.text: The description does not give whether the space is for fewer than 50 people, so the proposed occupancy group is not established.
The existing occupancy group of the space is not in public records; only plans or an inspection show it. A change of occupancy is not established.

Without what the space was last used as, whether the space is for fewer than 50 people and the existing occupancy group of the space, which only plans or an inspection show, the rules cannot say whether this is a change of use or of occupancy, so they cannot say which building permit applies: insufficient information.
basis.code_section: San Francisco Building Code § 106A.1; Planning Code § 175

referral_steps.text: Building permit application (and any other City permit or licence authorizing a use): this application is sent to the Planning Department for review (Planning Code § 175(a)).
